description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the OrderSetService in the OpenMRS core API. It tests functionality such as creating, updating, retrieving, retiring, and deleting OrderSet and OrderSetMember objects, as well as managing related attribute types and attributes. The tests verify the correct behavior and data integrity of the OrderSetService implementation within a context-sensitive testing environment.

classes.name: OrderSetServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for testing the OrderSetService class in the OpenMRS API. Contains setup methods and multiple test cases verifying the core functionalities such as CRUD operations, ordering, retiring, and attribute management related to OrderSet objects.

methods.name: runBeforeAllTests
methods.description: Initializes service dependencies before each test case runs to ensure the test environment is properly set up.

methods.name: shouldSaveOrderSet
methods.description: Tests saving a new OrderSet to ensure it's persisted correctly and the list size increases.

methods.name: shouldSaveAndUpdateOrderSet
methods.description: Verifies that saving an existing OrderSet updates its properties and tracks changes appropriately.

methods.name: shouldRetrieveOrderSetMembersOfAnOrderSet
methods.description: Checks retrieval of members within a specific OrderSet, including handling of retired members.

methods.name: shouldNotAutomaticallyPropagateToSetMembersIfExcludingOrderSet
methods.description: Ensures fetching order sets can exclude propagated set members based on parameters.

methods.name: shouldAddOrderSetMemberAtLastPositionInsideAnExistingOrderSetIfPositionIsNull
methods.description: Tests adding a member to an OrderSet without specifying a position, which should append to the end.

methods.name: shouldAddOrderSetMemberAtSomePositionInsideAnExistingOrderSet
methods.description: Tests inserting a new member at a specified position within an existing OrderSet.

methods.name: shouldReturnInTheSameArrangementInWhichTheOrderSetMembersAreSaved
methods.description: Verifies that the order of members is maintained after saving if set explicitly.

methods.name: shouldAddOrderSetMemberFromTheEndOfTheListIfNegativePositionIsGiven
methods.description: Checks behavior when adding a member with a negative index, which should add from the end.

methods.name: shouldFetchUnRetiredOrderSetMembers
methods.description: Ensures only non-retired members are returned when filtering.

methods.name: shouldDeleteAnOrderSetMemberInAnOrderSet
methods.description: Verifies that removing a member effectively reduces the list of members.

methods.name: shouldFetchOrderSetMemberByUuid
methods.description: Confirms retrieval of an OrderSetMember using its UUID, verifying proper data access.

methods.name: shouldRetireOrderSetAndOrderSetMembersAsWell
methods.description: Test that retiring an OrderSet also updates its members' retired status.

methods.name: orderSetBuilder
methods.description: Helper method to create sample OrderSet objects for testing with specified retired statuses.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeByUuid_shouldGetTheOrderSetAttributeWithTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Test fetching an OrderSetAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoOrderSetAttributeHasTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Test behavior when fetching a non-existent UUID for OrderSetAttribute.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByUuid_shouldReturnTheOrderSetAttributeTypeWithTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Test fetching an OrderSetAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoOrderSetAttributeTypeExistsWithTheGivenUuid
methods.description: Test behavior when fetching a non-existent UUID for OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeOrderSetAttributeType_shouldCompletelyRemoveAOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Test complete removal of an OrderSetAttributeType from the system.

methods.name: retireOrderSetAttributeType_shouldRetireAOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Tests retiring an OrderSetAttributeType, marking it as inactive.

methods.name: saveOrderSetAttributeType_shouldCreateANewOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Verifies creation of a new OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: saveOrderSetAttributeType_shouldEditAnExistingOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Tests editing an existing OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: unretireOrderSetAttributeType_shouldUnretireARetiredOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Checks the process of unretiring a previously retired OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByName_shouldGetMatchingOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches an OrderSetAttributeType by its name.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByName_shouldReturnNullForNonExistentName
methods.description: Verifies that searching for a non-existent attribute type name returns null.
